title: Fox Mascot in Reference Style
tests: Uses the second attachment as a style reference while preserving the first attachment's mascot identity and clothing.

judge.summary: The full-body fox retains its friendly face and orange hoodie in a polished, text-free square image with the reference’s pink-and-teal vaporwave styling.

must_haves.item: The main subject is recognisably the supplied fox mascot, not a replacement character or a copy of the reference poster alone.
must_haves.why: The fox preserves the supplied mascot’s facial features, markings, outfit, tail, and standing pose.

must_haves.item: The fox retains its orange hoodie and friendly appearance.
must_haves.why: The orange pullover hoodie and friendly smiling expression remain clearly visible.

must_haves.item: The fox's full body, including ears and feet, is visible.
must_haves.why: Both ears, both feet, and the entire body are inside the image with ample margins.

must_haves.item: Pink and teal gradients and a retro vaporwave treatment visibly connect the result to style-ref.jpg.
must_haves.why: The pink-to-teal sky, striped sun, palm silhouettes, neon perspective grid, and colored rim lighting strongly connect the result to the reference.

must_haves.item: The output is one square image with no added text.
must_haves.why: The output is a single square image and contains no visible text.
